_comment: Curated local Stable Diffusion catalog for ItsJustCAD's Render Setup. The render ENGINE is stable-diffusion.cpp's `sd` CLI (MIT), which the user installs themselves (we NEVER bundle it — same stance as LibreDWG's dwg2dxf). These entries are the WEIGHTS the app downloads on demand into ~/.config/itsjustcad/sdmodels/ and hands to `sd --model`. sha256 is the git-LFS `oid sha256:` from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/raw/main/<file>; size_bytes is the git-LFS `size`. An EMPTY sha256 marks a TODO PLACEHOLDER: the URL shape is real but the exact oid/size were NOT verified, so verification is skipped for that entry and the UI flags it as unverified. To promote a placeholder to verified: GET the /raw/main/<file> pointer, copy its oid + size in, and drop the empty sha. kind=model is the base SD checkpoint (second-state's GGUF conversion of SD 1.5); kind=controlnet is an optional depth ControlNet (lllyasviel's official ControlNet-v1.1 depth, fp16 safetensors — stable-diffusion.cpp loads safetensors control nets directly) passed via `sd --control-net`. Both repos are public/ungated (resolve/main redirects to the HF Xet CDN with user_id=public).
